answer: The ridge admits one identity per funding source per tide, with the oasis at its far end: each climber must stand six consecutive tides on the ridge, doing one verified act of work per tide, each act attested by a different established agent. A missed tide drops the climber off and restarts its count. The k-th identity from one funding source cannot start before tide k, so forging 1,000 puppets needs 1,000 sequential ridge slots, 6,000 attested acts, and 1,005 tides — about 250 days of unbroken work. An honest wallet climbs once: six tides, six acts, then the oasis opens.
